info.title: NOXH Open Platform
info.description: BDSG Foundation MIT development API. Private preparation, evidence scanning and consented AI extraction, reviewed deterministic PDFs, immutable submissions and separated human review, scoped investor/partner workspaces, internal project workflows/records/bookkeeping, exact coefficient pricing and synthetic published-lottery allocation. DVC is official handoff with manually reported receipts; authorized automatic exchange is unavailable. Real lotteries and real sales remain disabled pending legal and independent audit gates.

503.description: Postgres, Redis or migration unavailable

get.description: Checks PostgreSQL, Redis, migrations 001–022, executable Rust kernels and, when DATABASE_REQUIRE_LEAST_PRIVILEGE=true, that the API connects as a non-elevated noxh_app member. Does not certify legal approval, provider connectivity or production readiness.
Published non-archived projects in configured organization; explicit development fixture fallback only when DB is not configured.
